course.title: JavaScript 校验与解析
course.subtitle: 从真实代码里学会校验、解析与边界处理
course.subtitle_en: Learn validation, parsing and boundary handling from real code

lesson.title: 校验和：一位数字的重量

sections.h: 输错一位，系统怎么知道？
sections.p: 银行卡、ISBN、身份证号都带一位校验位。它不是随机的：由前面的数字按固定规则算出来。只要规则对上，大部分手滑错误——输错一位、相邻两位写反——会被立刻发现。
sections.h_en: One wrong digit — how does the system know?
sections.p_en: Bank cards, ISBNs and ID numbers all carry a check digit. It is not random: it is computed from the digits before it. When the rule matches, most slips — a mistyped digit, two adjacent digits swapped — are caught immediately.

sections.p: Luhn 是最常见的 mod 10 校验。从最右位开始，隔一位把数字乘 2；乘积大于 9 时把两位相加（15 变成 1+5=6）；全部加起来能被 10 整除就通过。
sections.h_en: Luhn: right to left, double every other digit
sections.p_en: Luhn is the most common mod 10 check. Start at the rightmost digit and double every second digit; if the product is greater than 9, add its two digits (15 becomes 1+5=6); if the total is divisible by 10, the number passes.

sections.p: ISBN-10 用 1 到 10 的权重做 mod 11，余数为 0 才合法；因为模 11 可能出现 10，所以最后一位允许写成 X。ISBN-13 用 1 和 3 交替加权做 mod 10，和 Luhn 是两种不同的规则。
sections.p_en: ISBN-10 uses weights 1 to 10 and a mod 11 check; the remainder must be 0. Because mod 11 can produce 10, the last character may be written as X. ISBN-13 uses alternating weights 1 and 3 with a mod 10 check — a different rule from Luhn.

sections.p: 校验和只擅长发现随机错误，不防伪造：知道规则的人可以构造一个校验通过的假号码。所以真实系统还要做长度、前缀、业务库、风控等检查。
sections.p_en: A checksum is good at catching random errors, not forgery: anyone who knows the rule can construct a fake number that passes. Real systems also check length, prefixes, business databases and risk rules.

lesson.keyIdea: 校验位是廉价的第一道过滤器：先排除手滑，再谈业务。
lesson.practice: 先做 Luhn，再做 ISBN：一个练循环，一个练两套规则并存。
lesson.lede: 校验和是最便宜的错误检测：一位数字，能挡住大量手滑。
lesson.title_en: Checksums: the weight of one digit
lesson.lede_en: A checksum is the cheapest error detector: one digit can catch a lot of typos.
lesson.keyIdea_en: A check digit is a cheap first filter: rule out slips before talking about business rules.
lesson.practice_en: Do Luhn first, then ISBN: one trains a loop, the other two rules living side by side.

lesson.title: 标识符与卡号：格式只是门卫

sections.p: 很多标识符的合法性由三件事决定：长度、允许的字符集、前缀范围。MongoDB 的 ObjectId 是 24 位十六进制；Visa 卡号以 4 开头；Mir 的 BIN 在 2200 到 2204 之间。正则通常只检查这三件事。
sections.p_en: Many identifiers are defined by three things: length, allowed characters, and a prefix range. A MongoDB ObjectId is 24 hexadecimal characters; a Visa card starts with 4; Mir BINs range from 2200 to 2204. A regex usually checks only these three things.

sections.p: 卡号即使命中机构正则，也要过 Luhn 校验。机构正则回答像不像，Luhn 回答数字本身有没有抄错。两层都过，才算格式合法。
sections.h_en: After the regex comes the checksum
sections.p_en: Even if a card number matches an issuer regex, it still has to pass Luhn. The issuer regex answers 'does it look right'; Luhn answers 'was a digit copied wrong'. Both layers must pass for the format to be valid.

sections.h: 格式合法不等于真实存在
sections.p: 一个 16 位数字可以通过所有格式检查，但仍然是编造的。格式校验只负责挡住明显错误；真实开卡、账户状态要查业务系统。
sections.p_en: A 16-digit number can pass every format check and still be invented. Format validation only blocks obvious mistakes; real card issuance and account status live in a business system.

lesson.keyIdea: 格式校验是门卫，不是数据库。
lesson.practice: 先用正则在 BIN 表里选机构，再用 Luhn 排除抄错。
lesson.lede: 卡号、ObjectId 这类标识符，格式只是第一层，校验和才是第二层。
lesson.title_en: Identifiers & card numbers: format is only the gatekeeper
lesson.lede_en: For identifiers such as card numbers and ObjectIds, format is the first layer; the checksum is the second.
lesson.keyIdea_en: Format validation is a gatekeeper, not a database.
lesson.practice_en: Use the regex to pick an issuer from the BIN table, then Luhn to rule out a miscopied digit.

lesson.title: 时间与编码：日期会骗人，Base64 不是加密

sections.p: new Date('2020-02-30') 不会报错，它会滚动到 3 月 1 日。判断日期是否真实存在，常用做法是构造 UTC 日期再回读：年、月、日必须和输入一致。闰年规则也因此自动生效。
sections.p_en: new Date('2020-02-30') does not throw; it rolls over to March 1. To check whether a date really exists, construct a UTC date and read it back: year, month and day must match the input. Leap-year rules then apply automatically.

sections.p: 同一套格式可以接受斜杠和连字符，严格模式则要求输入分隔符和格式一致。两位年份还要决定世纪：validator.js 以当前年份的后两位为界，小于它归到 20xx，否则归到 19xx。
sections.p_en: One format can accept slashes and hyphens; strict mode requires the input delimiter to match the format. Two-digit years also need a century: validator.js uses the last two digits of the current year as the boundary — lower goes to 20xx, otherwise 19xx.

sections.p: Base64 只是把任意字节映射到 64 个可打印字符，任何人都能解码。标准字母表用 + 和 /，URL-safe 版本换成 - 和 _；padding 用 = 补齐到 4 的倍数。
sections.p_en: Base64 maps arbitrary bytes to 64 printable characters; anyone can decode it. The standard alphabet uses + and /, the URL-safe variant uses - and _; padding with = brings the length to a multiple of 4.

lesson.keyIdea: 日期要回读，编码要分清字母表和 padding。
lesson.practice: 一道题练日期回读，一道题练默认值与 URL-safe 的耦合。
lesson.lede: 日期字符串会滚动，Base64 不是加密——两个最容易被想当然的地方。
lesson.title_en: Time & encoding: dates lie, Base64 is not encryption
lesson.lede_en: Date strings roll over, and Base64 is not encryption — two things that are easy to take for granted.
lesson.keyIdea_en: Read dates back; know the alphabet and padding of an encoding.
lesson.practice_en: One exercise trains date round-tripping; the other trains defaults and URL-safe coupling.

lesson.title: 数据与安全：解析成功不等于类型正确

sections.h: 解析成功不等于类型正确
sections.p: JSON.parse('null') 是合法的，JSON.parse('123') 也是。很多接口只接受对象或数组，所以校验器要区分能解析和是我们要的类型。allow_primitives 和 allow_any_value 就是在放松这层限制。
sections.h_en: Parsing successfully is not the right type
sections.p_en: JSON.parse('null') is valid, and so is JSON.parse('123'). Many APIs only accept objects or arrays, so a validator must distinguish 'parses' from 'is the type we want'. allow_primitives and allow_any_value relax that boundary.

sections.h: 口令强度不是字符种类堆砌
sections.p: 长度、大小写、数字、符号是常见门槛，但 Aaaa111! 依然很弱。唯一字符数能挡住大量重复；真正的强度还取决于是否出现在泄露库、是否可预测。
sections.h_en: Password strength is not a pile of character classes
sections.p_en: Length, case, digits and symbols are common gates, but Aaaa111! is still weak. The number of unique characters blocks heavy repetition; real strength also depends on breach lists and predictability.

sections.p: 前端校验只改善体验，不能替代服务端校验。格式合法不代表安全：限流、哈希存储、泄露检测、二次验证，都不在正则能解决的范围内。
sections.p_en: Client-side validation improves the experience; it cannot replace server-side checks. A valid format does not mean safe: rate limiting, hashed storage, breach detection and second-factor checks are outside what a regex can do.

lesson.keyIdea: 校验器负责说不合法，不负责说安全。
lesson.practice: 一道题练 JSON 的类型边界，一道题练口令的唯一字符阈值。
lesson.lede: 能解析不等于类型正确，字符种类多不等于口令强。
lesson.title_en: Data & security: parsing successfully is not the same as having the right type
lesson.lede_en: Parsing successfully does not mean the type is right; many character classes do not make a password strong.
lesson.keyIdea_en: A validator says invalid; it does not say safe.
lesson.practice_en: One exercise trains JSON type boundaries; the other trains the unique-character threshold.

lesson.title: 毕业项目：注册表单校验器

sections.p: 注册表单同时涉及字符串、邮箱、口令和日期。你要写一个 validateSignup(payload)，返回 { ok, errors }；errors 只包含出错的字段，值是错误码。
sections.p_en: A registration form touches strings, email, passwords and dates. Implement validateSignup(payload) returning { ok, errors }; errors contains only the invalid fields, and each value is an error code.

sections.p: name 去掉首尾空格后 2 到 40 个字符；email 需要满足简单的邮箱形状；password 至少 8 位，且包含小写、大写、数字和符号 !@#$%^&* 中的至少一个；birthdate 必须是 YYYY-MM-DD 的真实日期，不能是未来，且以 2026-11-10 为基准年满 13 岁。
sections.p_en: name: 2-40 characters after trimming; email: a simple email shape; password: at least 8 characters with at least one lowercase, uppercase, digit and symbol from !@#$%^&*; birthdate: a real YYYY-MM-DD date, not in the future, and at least 13 years old relative to 2026-11-10.

sections.p: 12 条测试覆盖：全合法、四个字段分别出错、未来日期、刚满 13 岁、空对象。先让参考解全过，再让起始代码至少挂一条。
sections.p_en: 12 tests cover: a fully valid form, each field failing, a future date, exactly 13 years old, and an empty object. Make the reference solution pass all of them, and the starter fail at least one.

lesson.keyIdea: 校验的顺序不重要，错误码的稳定性很重要——调用方要靠它做提示。
lesson.practice: 做完这一题，你就是这门课的 Maintainer。
lesson.lede: 把四章的规则拼成一个注册表单校验器。
lesson.lede_en: Combine the rules from four chapters into one registration form validator.
lesson.keyIdea_en: Order does not matter; stable error codes do — callers use them to show messages.
lesson.practice_en: Finish this and you are the Maintainer of this course.
